plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Albums whose old release is greyed out on YouTube (e.g. re-issued, or the artist renamed) now play all tracks, using the current copies. Search results show the real album and length instead of the play count.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
